📖 How to Play "Journey of the Craft Villages 3D"

👥 1. Game Mode (1 to 5 Players & NPC Gia Hân)

The game has up to 5 Merchants in Vietnamese costumes: Minh Khôi, Mai Anh, Bảo Long, Thảo Nhi and Gia Hân. Click the "5 Players" button on the toolbar to play solo against 4 NPCs, or switch characters to "👤 Player" so friends and family can roll the dice together on one screen!

🗺️ 2. A Closed Loop Journey Through 47 Landmarks

Everyone starts with 300 dong. Pawns travel a closed loop through 47 landmarks placed in their true geographic regions: from Uncle Ho's Mausoleum - Hanoi (#0) down the Northern Delta coast and the Central Coast (out to Ly Son island #11) to the South, across the sea to Phu Quoc (#24) → back up through the Mekong Delta, the Southeast and the Central Highlands (#25–#35) → Quang Tri Citadel, Nghe An, the Northwest and the Northeast (#36–#46), then closing the loop back at Hanoi. There are 6 Event / Skill tiles and 4 Tool Stations (Van Don, Tien Sa, Cai Rang, Northwest Market).

🛠️ 3. Invest in Craft Villages & Use Tool Cards to Dodge Fees

• Invest in a Craft Village: Every craft village shows its 3D model from the start of the game. Stop at a village with no owner and click [Invest in Craft Village] to reach 1 Star, plant your ownership flag and start collecting experience fees.
• Upgrade Service: On later turns, when you stop at your own village, click [Upgrade Service] to climb 2 → 3 → 4 → 5 Stars (International Standard). More stars means higher fees - 5 Stars is the highest. The star count shows as golden stars floating above the model.
• Owned Land: You must complete the craft challenge (e.g. simmering Ben Tre coconut candy, painting Lai Thieu piggy banks, harvesting Nha Trang bird's nests...). If you hold a matching Tool Card (bought at the 4 Rest Stops) or a VIP Visit Pass → 100% FREE! With no tool → you must pay the service fee in cash to the landowner.

⚡ 4. A Stack of 10 Event Cards (!) & 7 Skill Cards (?)

• 10 Event Cards (!): Instant market effects (Price storm x2, Bumper harvest x2, 5-star OCOP +120đ, UNESCO honor with a free tool, Heritage train, Spring tides...).
• 7 Skill Cards (?): Keep them in hand and activate when it pays off (Master haggler -30%, VIP pass, Express double dice roll, Artisan's secret for 2 free tools, Cooperative alliance, Tourism ambassador, Merchant's leap).
